instagram.caption:
The drawer everyone calls the junk drawer.
The Utensil and Utility Drawers in the Kitchen. The shallow drawers holding hand tools: flatware, spatulas, peelers, measuring spoons, foil and wraps.

What done looks like:
1. Each drawer has one job
2. A name written inside its front edge. Flatware sits in a divided insert with nothing loose beside it. Foil
3. Baking paper stand on end so you can read the boxes from above. Every drawer closes flush with one push
